scripts.setup: if [ -f "$POLYSCOPE_ROOT_PATH/.env.local" ] && [ ! -f .env.local ]; then cp "$POLYSCOPE_ROOT_PATH/.env.local" .env.local; fi && bun setup

tasks.label: Rebase on main

tasks.label: Merge gate + PR
